inputs.description: Master key. Use it only to manage API keys, and give clients the search or admin keys from GET /keys. Generated at installation.
inputs.name: masterKey

zh-CN.summary: 快速的搜索引擎，用主密钥保护，索引存在卷上。

zh-TW.summary: 快速的搜尋引擎，用主金鑰保護，索引存在磁碟區。

metadata.name: Meilisearch
metadata.summary: A fast search engine with a master key and indexes on a volume.

zh-CN.summary: 以 UID 1000 运行，文件系统只读，没有 Kubernetes 令牌，也去掉了所有额外的系统权限。生产模式必须有主密钥。Ingress 路由是公开的。

zh-TW.summary: 以 UID 1000 執行，檔案系統唯讀，沒有 Kubernetes 權杖，也拿掉了所有額外的系統權限。正式模式一定要有主金鑰。Ingress 路由是公開的。

zh-CN.mitigation: 没有有效密钥的请求都会被拒绝，搜索预览页面也已关闭。给浏览器的只能是搜索密钥或租户令牌，千万不要把主密钥给它。
zh-CN.risk: 任何人都能从网络访问 Ingress 上的 API。

zh-TW.mitigation: 沒有有效金鑰的請求都會被拒絕，搜尋預覽頁面也已關閉。給瀏覽器的只能是搜尋金鑰或租戶權杖，千萬不要把主金鑰給它。
zh-TW.risk: 任何人都能從網路連到 Ingress 上的 API。

risks.mitigation: Without a valid key, Meilisearch rejects requests. The search preview page is off. Give browsers only a search key or a tenant token. Never give them the master key.
risks.risk: Anyone on the internet can reach the API through the Ingress.

zh-CN.mitigation: 只设置你信任的服务商地址。也可以加一条 egress NetworkPolicy（限制对外连接的规则）来限制。
zh-CN.risk: AI 搜索的嵌入服务、webhook 和网络搜索都会对外连接，模板没有限制。有人可能把其中一个设置指向内部的私有地址。

zh-TW.mitigation: 只設定你信任的服務商位址。也可以加一條 egress NetworkPolicy（限制對外連線的規則）來限制。
zh-TW.risk: AI 搜尋的嵌入服務、webhook 和網路搜尋都會對外連線，範本沒有限制。有人可能把其中一個設定指向內部的私有位址。

risks.mitigation: Set up only provider endpoints you trust. You can also add an egress NetworkPolicy (a rule that limits outbound traffic) to restrict them.
risks.risk: AI-powered search embedders, webhooks and network search make outbound calls, and the template does not limit them. Someone could point one at a private address.

zh-CN.mitigation: 分片、复制和 S3 快照会返回 requires_enterprise_edition 错误。要用这些功能得另外使用企业版镜像，它采用 BUSL-1.1 许可，生产环境使用要买商业许可。
zh-CN.risk: 这个镜像不含企业版功能。

zh-TW.mitigation: 分片、複寫和 S3 快照會回傳 requires_enterprise_edition 錯誤。要用這些功能得另外使用企業版映像檔，它採用 BUSL-1.1 授權，正式環境使用要買商業授權。
zh-TW.risk: 這個映像檔不含企業版功能。

risks.mitigation: Sharding, replication and S3 snapshots return a requires_enterprise_edition error. They need the separate Enterprise image, which uses the BUSL-1.1 license and needs a commercial license for production use.
risks.risk: Enterprise Edition features are not in this image.

security.summary: The container runs as UID 1000 with a read-only filesystem, no Kubernetes token and all extra system privileges removed. Production mode needs the master key. The ingress route is public.

manifests:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: meilisearch-data
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 20Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: meilisearch
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  serviceName: meilisearch
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: meilisearch
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: meilisearch
        app.kubernetes.io/name: meilisearch
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: meilisearch
        image: getmeili/meilisearch:v1.56.1@sha256:b7ba431bf6f9b26cc86132798f3640964147a699cf23f026b74c6c05dbb1d60d
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 7700
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop: [ALL]
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 512Mi
          limits:
            cpu: '2'
            memory: 2Gi
        env:
        - name: MEILI_ENV
          value: production
        - name: MEILI_MASTER_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: meilisearch-secrets
              key: master-key
        - name: MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS
          value: 'true'
        - name: MEILI_DB_PATH
          value: /meili_data/data.ms
        - name: MEILI_DUMP_DIR
          value: /meili_data/dumps
        - name: MEILI_SNAPSHOT_DIR
          value: /meili_data/snapshots
        - name: MEILI_MAX_INDEXING_MEMORY
          value: '1073741824'
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /meili_data
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        startupProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 120
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 6
      volumes:
      - name: data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: meilisearch-data
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 2Gi
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: meilisearch
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: meilisearch
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 7700
    targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: meilisearch
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: '{{ .ClusterIssuer }}'
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  tls:
  - hosts: ['{{ .Domain }}']
    secretName: meilisearch-tls
  rules:
  - host: '{{ .Domain }}'
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: meilisearch
            port:
              number: 7700
